evidence_sentence: The function first checks if the socket buffer is non-linear or if its length is less than the size of a netlink attribute.
rationale: The fixed implementation adds the explicit check `skb->len < sizeof(struct nlattr)` before computing `skb->len - sizeof(struct nlattr)`. The vulnerable implementation checks only whether the buffer is non-linear and then performs the subtraction in the offset check, so the stated length guard is specific to the fixed version.
rewritten_docstring: The function first checks whether the socket buffer is suitable for the search. It then verifies that the provided offset A is valid. If all checks pass, it searches for the netlink attribute of type X starting from the calculated position. If found, it returns the offset of the attribute relative to the start of the socket buffer; otherwise, it returns 0.
